# dlarfgp

> Generates a real elementary reflector with non-negative beta.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import dlarfgp from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/dlarfgp';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
dlarfgp( N, alpha, x, strideX, tau ) → Float64Array
```

Generates a real elementary reflector `H` of order `N` with non-negative `beta`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the reflector |
| `alpha` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · On entry, the scalar `alpha`; on exit, the scalar `beta` (non-negative) |
| `x` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length 1 + (N - 2) * abs(incx)</sub> | **in/out** · Input array, overwritten with `v` on exit |
| ↳ `strideX` | `integer` | Stride length for `x` |
| `tau` | `Float64Array` | **out** · Output scalar |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The order of the elementary reflector.
- `alpha`: On entry, the value $\alpha$. On exit, it is overwritten with the value $\beta$.
- `x`: On entry, the vector x. On exit, it is overwritten with the vector v.
- `tau`: The value $\tau$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`

**Throws**

- `RangeError` first argument must be a nonnegative integer

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
dlarfgp.ndarray(
    N,
    alpha, offsetAlpha,
    x, strideX, offsetX,
    tau, offsetTau
) → Float64Array
```

Generates a real elementary reflector `H` of order `N` with non-negative `beta`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the reflector |
| `alpha` | `Float64Array` | **in/out** · On entry, the scalar `alpha`; on exit, the scalar `beta` (non-negative) |
| ↳ `offsetAlpha` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Index into `alpha` |
| `x` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length 1 + (N - 2) * abs(incx)</sub> | **in/out** · Vector, overwritten with `v` on exit |
| ↳ `strideX` | `integer` | Stride for `x` |
| ↳ `offsetX` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `x` |
| `tau` | `Float64Array` | **out** · Output scalar |
| ↳ `offsetTau` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Index into `tau` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The order of the elementary reflector.
- `alpha`: On entry, the value $\alpha$. On exit, it is overwritten with the value $\beta$.
- `x`: On entry, the vector x. On exit, it is overwritten with the vector v.
- `tau`: The value $\tau$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`

**Throws**

- `RangeError` first argument must be a nonnegative integer

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `dlarfgp()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`DLARFGP`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/dlarfgp.f).
-   Unlike `dlarfg`, on exit the scalar `beta` written to `alpha` is guaranteed to be non-negative. When `x` is (relatively) zero and `alpha` is negative, `tau` is set to `2.0` and `alpha` is flipped to `-alpha` (non-negative). When `x` is zero and `alpha` is non-negative, `tau` is set to `0.0`.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Float64Array from '@stdlib/array/float64/lib/index.js';
import dlarfgp from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/dlarfgp';

const alpha = new Float64Array( [ 3.0 ] );
const x = new Float64Array( [ 4.0, 0.0, 0.0 ] );
const tau = new Float64Array( 1 );

// Compute the reflector so that applying H to ( alpha, x ) gives ( beta, 0 ) with beta >= 0:
dlarfgp( 4, alpha, x, 1, tau );

console.log( 'beta = %d', alpha[ 0 ] ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
console.log( 'tau  = %d', tau[ 0 ] ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
console.log( 'v    =', x ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="reference-notes">

## Reference notes

The mathematical description from the reference LAPACK 3.12.0 source of `DLARFGP`. Indices are the 1-based Fortran indices of the source.

### Purpose

DLARFGP generates a real elementary reflector H of order n, such that

$$
H \, \begin{pmatrix} \alpha \\ x \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} \beta \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} , H^T \, H = I
$$

where $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are scalars, $\beta$ is non-negative, and x is an (n-1)-element real vector. H is represented in the form

$$
H = I - \tau \, \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ v \end{pmatrix} \, ( 1 v^T )
$$

where $\tau$ is a real scalar and v is a real (n-1)-element vector.

If the elements of x are all zero, then $\tau = 0$ and H is taken to be the unit matrix.

</section>
